datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics and the limitations of the sources used to implement those results.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts reviewed satellite imagery to delineate wind speed exposure zones from Hurricane Matthew and intersected these zones with population distribution data to quantify population exposure at three wind speed thresholds (60, 90, and 120 km/h) across administrative divisions in Haiti.

sources.name: United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite imagery analysis of Hurricane Matthew wind speed zones and population exposure mapping conducted on 2016-10-06
